lastCompletedStory.title: Spawn the orchestrator root persona under `claude --agent` with a meta_loop-aware boot nudge

nextStoryContext: Both stories in this PRD (US-001, US-002) now pass. buildOrchestratorPaneCommand's claude invocation (src/commands/run.ts) now launches `--agent subagent-orchestrator`; setup.ts's buildSetupMenuScript() handoff() function does the same for the cam init fresh-boot split. buildOrchestratorBootPrompt() shrank to a minimal meta_loop-aware nudge (readMetaLoop-forked: 'auto' announces autonomous mode and omits the closing question, 'off'/'observe' greet and ask) -- all the former boot-imperatives (readiness marker, CAM_ORCH_REHYDRATE, backlog derivation via cam issue list) now live ONLY in the agent body's Boot context section (already folded in by US-001), asserted by test/vendor/orchestrator-backlog-derivation.test.ts's embedded-persona describe block. The Identity section's frontmatter note was flipped from 'advisory-only' to 'runtime-binding' in both .claude/agents/ and templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (dual-copy, re-embedded via bun run embed-vendor) since --agent is now the actual spawn mode. RUNTIME-ENFORCEMENT CAVEAT (unchanged from US-001): whether delegation still works, Edit is actually denied, and self-handoff/respawn correctly rehydrates under --agent is UNVERIFIED-IN-CI (CAM-42: no authenticated interactive claude TUI in the autonomous pipeline) and remains gated on the operator live-validation ceremony filed as CAM-253 -- typecheck/tests exercise argv shape and meta_loop branching only, never a live authenticated session. Two pre-existing tests were pruned/rewritten this story because their assertions pinned content that correctly no longer lives in the boot-prompt string (moved to the agent body): test/run.test.ts's old 'buildOrchestratorBootPrompt (CAM-23 rehydration directive)' describe block, and the boot-prompt half of test/vendor/orchestrator-backlog-derivation.test.ts (the embedded-persona half survives untouched). File-size budget raised for test/run.test.ts (962->963) and test/setup-menu.test.ts (77->82) with a CAM-240 tracker reference in scripts/file-size-budget.json's _ref. With the PRD's only two stories now passing, the next dispatch is the review cycle (subagent-reviewer / autonomous sidecar review pass), not another implementer story.

officialDocsValidated.lib: Claude Code CLI --agent flag (code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents + claudelog.com FAQ cross-check)
officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed via WebFetch + WebSearch cross-check: 'claude --agent <name>' transforms the main thread itself into that subagent's persona -- the agent's system prompt replaces the default entirely, 'only tools allowed by the agent are available' (tools:/disallowedTools: is runtime-enforced, not advisory), and a trailing message argument is still accepted as the first user turn (matches AC#1's assembled invocation shape: --model <model> --agent subagent-orchestrator <boot-nudge>). This matches the implementation: buildOrchestratorPaneCommand appends --agent subagent-orchestrator before the cat-of-promptFile argument, and setup.ts's handoff() does the same.
